captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 首先就感谢大家今天的一个到来
captions.en: First, thank you all for coming today.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 这个就是作为我们为什么要做这个沙龙
captions.en: This is why we wanted to hold this salon.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 首先最简单的，就是在AI这个时代下
captions.en: The simplest reason is that, in the age of AI,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我们所有的生活工作，已经被AI已经有所影响
captions.en: AI is already affecting every part of our lives and work.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 而且不断地在被改变
captions.en: And it keeps changing them.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 在这个过程当中，我们
captions.en: In this process, all of us—

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 不管是现在所谓的这些OPC创业也好
captions.en: whether we are so-called OPC entrepreneurs,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 还是咱们现在的企业主
captions.en: business owners,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 或者是自身做的一些相关业务
captions.en: or running our own related businesses—

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 它都在被AI不断地去改变
captions.en: are being continually changed by AI.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 但是在这个过程当中呢
captions.en: But along the way,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我们大家都遇到了很多的问题，这些问题
captions.en: we have all encountered many problems.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我们在没有和大多数人进行交流的时候
captions.en: Before we had talked with more people,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 刚开始呢，大家都是在通过AI的不断的这个
captions.en: we initially tried to use AI itself,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 自我的这种询问和交流
captions.en: asking it questions and talking with it,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 去找和破解这些问题
captions.en: to find answers and solve these problems.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 但是回归到我们现实当中
captions.en: But when we returned to the real world,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 发现很多现实世界遇到的这些经验和这些问题呢
captions.en: we found that real-world experience and problems

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 跟AI最终给出的答案都不一致
captions.en: often did not match the answers AI gave us.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 所以这也是我们办这个沙龙的一个初衷
captions.en: That is the original purpose of this salon.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 就是作为在甘肃兰州本地来说
captions.en: Here in Lanzhou, Gansu,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我们会用AI的和现在想用AI的这些人
captions.en: people who use AI and people who want to use it

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 遇到的这些问题
captions.en: all encounter these problems.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我们如何能够通过大家线下的这种碰面
captions.en: So how can meeting offline

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 每个月组织一次，来把这些问题挖出来
captions.en: once a month help us uncover them,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 然后呢，大家去解决
captions.en: and then solve them together?

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 再一个呢，就是说
captions.en: Another goal is

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 把我们的这些身边的一些现实世界的一些资源
captions.en: to bring together the real-world resources around us.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 就是因为AI它毕竟是一个工具
captions.en: After all, AI is a tool.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我们要利用这个工具去解决我们现实世界的问题
captions.en: We need to use it to solve real-world problems.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我们比喻现在的AI时代，它就像春天一朵
captions.en: The AI era is like a flower in spring.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 那么一朵花可以种植在花园里
captions.en: A flower may be planted in a garden,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 但它一定开放在春天里
captions.en: but it can only bloom in spring.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 我有一个自媒体账号，老徐聊医保
captions.en: I run a media account called 'Lao Xu Talks Medical Insurance.'

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 这个账号呢，我已经做了两年多
captions.en: I have been running it for more than two years.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 在这个医保飞检、基金监管和合规的这个
captions.en: It focuses on medical-insurance inspections, fund oversight, and compliance.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 这个账号在全国呢，也算是头部
captions.en: The account is considered one of the leading ones nationwide.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 也给保险公司讲课，一节课是一万五
captions.en: I also teach insurance companies, at 15,000 yuan per session.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 这个工作，我医保做了二十年
captions.en: I have worked in medical insurance for twenty years.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 所以我从我自己做自媒体开始
captions.en: As for how I started creating content,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 我是2023年10月
captions.en: it was in October 2023,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 也就差不多这个十天
captions.en: around this time of the month.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 我去新疆出差的时候，刚好在宾馆里面没有事
captions.en: I was on a business trip in Xinjiang, with nothing to do at the hotel.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 老有人，周围的朋友呢
captions.en: People around me, especially friends,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 老是问我一些医保的一些问题啊、政策
captions.en: kept asking me about medical insurance and its policies.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 我说给一个人说，还不如用自媒体给大家都说
captions.en: I thought, instead of telling one person, why not tell everyone online?

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 结果就开始做这个自媒体，很简单，就是口播视频
captions.en: So I started making simple talking-head videos.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 刚开始做的时候也非常痛苦
captions.en: It was very painful at first.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 就是这个面子
captions.en: I was self-conscious about being on camera.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 做一条视频可能要一天，甚至两天
captions.en: One video could take a day, or even two.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 但是后面呢，慢慢越来越熟悉之后呢
captions.en: But as I gradually became more familiar with it,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 现在可能我写文案、剪辑到发布
captions.en: now, from writing and editing to publishing,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 可能就是四十分钟之内就搞定了
captions.en: I can finish everything within forty minutes.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 你说让我现在做这个
captions.en: If you ask me to make videos for traffic now,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 我的视频做流量，我现在非常游刃有余
captions.en: I am very comfortable with it.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 我知道哪一个流量能
captions.en: I know what kind of traffic a topic can get,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 播放量会有多少，说什么样的话题，播放量会有多少
captions.en: and roughly how many views different topics will receive.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 我在抖音最高的一个播放量有一千多万
captions.en: My highest-viewed Douyin video has over ten million views.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 然后视频号呢，有一百多万、八十多万
captions.en: On WeChat Channels, some have over a million or over 800,000.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 然后我基本上发一个现在的视频，就是一般的播放量
captions.en: Now, when I publish an ordinary video,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 就是基本上我都能、都能、都能掌握的，流量这个能清楚了
captions.en: I can generally predict and understand its traffic.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 但是最后就卡到这个公域的流量
captions.en: But I am stuck on converting public traffic

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 转化到私域里面怎么成交，卡到这上
captions.en: into private traffic and closing sales.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 但是最终呢，它这个东西
captions.en: In the end,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 最终我们所说的要变现这个东西
captions.en: the goal is still monetization.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 就是走到，我可能已经走了80%了
captions.en: I may have already completed 80 percent of the journey,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 最后的20%就卡到这种问题上
captions.en: but I am stuck on the final 20 percent.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 在网上你去问所有的一些
captions.en: When you ask people online,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 他说你要挂课、留资等
captions.en: they tell you to sell courses, collect leads, and so on.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 都会有很多的答案
captions.en: There are plenty of answers,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 但是实际走的过程中是走不通的
captions.en: but they do not work in practice.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 这也是我最近比较困惑的
captions.en: That has been my main concern recently.

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 希望在下次直播前
captions.en: Before my next livestream,

captions.speaker: 老徐
captions.zh: 我能在这个沙龙里面看能不能解决我就这个问题
captions.en: I hope this salon can help me solve this problem.

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: 我做了一个什么东西呢？因为我的父母都是老师啊
captions.en: What did I build? Both of my parents are teachers.

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: 我就是给他们做，这个肯定也有人做过
captions.en: I built it for them. Others have surely done something similar,

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: 但是我那会儿也没有去参考别人，去做自己的事情
captions.en: but I did not look at their work then; I just built my own thing.

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: 平时上学啊，去聊那些事情
captions.en: We usually talk about these issues at school.

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: 我就做了一个类似于这个
captions.en: So I built something like

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: AI整个教学系统的一个平台
captions.en: an AI-powered teaching platform.

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: 这个平台大概是怎么样的呢？我简单说
captions.en: What does the platform do? Let me explain briefly.

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: 这个比赛呢，报名的数是三万七千多人
captions.en: More than 37,000 people entered this competition.

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: 今年拿AI没做别的事
captions.en: I did nothing else with AI this year.

captions.speaker: 魏元甲
captions.zh: 我只是在这个比赛上拿了一个全国前两千的名次
captions.en: I only used it to place among the top 2,000 nationwide.

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 我是在观望，我是在看
captions.en: I am still observing and watching.

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 但是的话，我是就像那个超哥讲的
captions.en: But, as Brother Chao said,

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 这个落地怎么落地
captions.en: the question is how to make it work in practice.

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 我手里面有大量的中小企业
captions.en: I have access to many small and medium-sized businesses,

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 对不对？而且我手里有大量的业务员
captions.en: and I also have many salespeople.

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 我可以就是说，你们这一块，就像超哥那一块
captions.en: So, for work like what Brother Chao does,

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 小程序啊、网站啊，这一块你们弄得好
captions.en: if you are good at mini programs and websites,

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 我就是中间的桥梁
captions.en: I can serve as the bridge.

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 你们跟客户之间的那种沟通也好
captions.en: We can handle communication between you and the client,

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 然后去交付也好，这一块是我们来干
captions.en: and we can handle delivery as well.

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 有一点，我觉得大家有点误区
captions.en: I think there is one common misconception.

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 不是说，哎，能做什么
captions.en: The question is not simply, 'What can it do?'

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 你看，能做这，能做到
captions.en: or, 'Look, it can do this and that.'

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 而是作为中小企业，我自己本身最需要什么
captions.en: As an SME, what do I actually need most?

captions.speaker: 黄鹏飞
captions.zh: 就是说，这个东西能解决我什么样的问题
captions.en: What problem can this thing solve for me?

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 比如说做这种，做这种就是知识付费
captions.en: For example, this kind of work is paid knowledge content.

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 因为这个知识付费这一块，也是我们公司的未来
captions.en: Paid knowledge content is also a future direction for our company,

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 主要的一个方向
captions.en: and one of our main focuses.

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 就是说做知识付费的这一块
captions.en: When you work in paid knowledge content,

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 它是有明确的、严格的法律界限规定的
captions.en: there are clear and strict legal boundaries.

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 那么我们如果说没有踩好
captions.en: If we do not handle them properly

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 规避好在这个红线以内
captions.en: and stay within the red lines,

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 比如说我们去做这个知识付费，我们就很容易踩雷
captions.en: we can easily get into trouble when offering paid knowledge content.

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 前提是什么？是不是我自己得会做
captions.en: The prerequisite is: shouldn't I know how to do it myself first?

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 我自己得会做，而且我自己会做了以后
captions.en: I need to know how, and after I have done it myself,

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 就是我自己实际的，我赚到钱了以后，我变现了以后
captions.en: after I have earned money from it and monetized it,

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 我才能够带着别人去做，那如果我自己都不会做的话
captions.en: then I can guide others. If I cannot do it myself,

captions.speaker: 李女士
captions.zh: 我来今天我带着你做，我觉得我很就很不负责任
captions.en: claiming I can lead you would be very irresponsible.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 下午好，我是飞书生态伙伴，西北区负责人洪岩
captions.en: Good afternoon. I am Hong Yan, the Northwest regional lead for a Feishu ecosystem partner.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 非常感谢超哥，因为我是超哥的粉丝，今天是第一次见面
captions.en: Thank you, Brother Chao. I am a fan, and this is our first meeting.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 我偶尔刷视频，看到在兰州还有这样的OPC
captions.en: I sometimes see your videos and realized Lanzhou has an OPC like this,

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 介绍AI的一些工具
captions.en: introducing different AI tools.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 听说有这样的活动，确实也是挺好的
captions.en: I heard about this event and thought it was a great idea.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 你想让你的Agent、让你的AI工具给你回答
captions.en: If you want your agent or AI tool

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 提供非常精准或者你需要的结果
captions.en: to give you precise results that fit your needs,

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 那你就得有企业的数据
captions.en: you need your company's data.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 得有企业高价值的一些信息，这些都可以沉淀在飞书上
captions.en: You need high-value company information, and it can all be accumulated in Feishu.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 现在好多之前飞书的用户
captions.en: Many existing Feishu users

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 马上就能跨到Agent办公
captions.en: can quickly move into agent-based work,

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 因为他们之前不管是聊天记录
captions.en: because their past chat records,

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 每个文档、群里的消息
captions.en: documents, and group messages,

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 不管是开的会、建的日程等等这一系列的
captions.en: meetings, calendars, and everything else,

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 或者多维表格里的数据、业务流程
captions.en: including data and workflows in multidimensional tables,

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 这些都是沉淀下来的
captions.en: have already been preserved there.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 我们公司会写代码，但是不懂你的业务
captions.en: Our company can write code, but we do not understand your business.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 所以像徐总这样的超级个体越来越值钱
captions.en: That is why solo operators like Mr. Xu are becoming more valuable.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 因为你懂业务，有高价值的知识库、高价值的数据
captions.en: You understand the business and have a high-value knowledge base and data.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 我觉得这才是最重要的
captions.en: I think that is what matters most.

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 接下来我们的OPC一定要在自己熟悉的行业
captions.en: In the future, OPCs must work in industries they know well,

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 或者是你有专家对你做支持的行业
captions.en: or industries where experts can support them,

captions.speaker: 洪岩
captions.zh: 结合运营经验、好的知识和数据，在垂直领域里做深耕
captions.en: combining operational experience, strong knowledge, and data to go deep in a vertical field.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 我是葛永鹏啊，昨天看到这个活动的发起
captions.en: I am Ge Yongpeng. I saw this event announced yesterday

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 昨天才报的，我们其实还在
captions.en: and only signed up then. We are still

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 传统的行业里面打转
captions.en: working within a traditional industry.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 所以今天我只是带着耳朵和眼睛去听和看
captions.en: So today I simply came to listen and observe.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 结果才发现我们落后了这么多
captions.en: Only then did I realize how far behind we are.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 兰州这么多的人已经开始行动了
captions.en: So many people in Lanzhou have already taken action.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 像徐总做得这么成功
captions.en: Mr. Xu has been very successful.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 对他来说，一个IP打造、获得流量那么方便
captions.en: For him, building a personal brand and gaining traffic is easy.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 对他是轻车熟路
captions.en: It is all familiar territory for him.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 这是多少人现在想做做不到的事情
captions.en: Yet so many people want to do this and cannot.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 所以很感谢，得一会儿加一下超哥微信
captions.en: So I am very grateful. I will add Brother Chao on WeChat later.

captions.speaker: 葛永鹏
captions.zh: 希望以后有机会多来听、多来学习，谢谢
captions.en: I hope I can come more often to listen and learn. Thank you.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 我叫韩志鑫，我是西北师范大学的
captions.en: My name is Han Zhixin, and I attend Northwest Normal University.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 本科是学计算机的
captions.en: I study computer science as an undergraduate.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 但是我们学校里面从来不会教AI这些东西
captions.en: But our school never teaches us about AI.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 就一直在折腾、一直在自己用
captions.en: So I have kept exploring and using it on my own.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 同时我自己也做短视频
captions.en: I also make short videos.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 我发现做短视频也会遇见一个问题
captions.en: I found that short-video production has a problem too.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 我觉得AI再强，人的判断也是特别重要的
captions.en: No matter how strong AI is, human judgment remains crucial.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 你就让它写出一百篇文案来，你不知道哪个好，有啥用呢
captions.en: If it writes a hundred scripts and you cannot tell which is good, what is the use?

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 我们还在做一些设计
captions.en: We also do some design work.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 就用GPT的Image Tool来出一些效果图
captions.en: We use GPT's Image Tool to create concept visuals.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 甚至现在都可以出矢量图，都完全可以
captions.en: It can even produce vector graphics now. It really can.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 设计这个东西，我都感觉快要被干掉了
captions.en: As a designer, I feel like I am about to be replaced.

captions.speaker: 韩志鑫
captions.zh: 我向前辈学习，我还是比较年轻
captions.en: I am here to learn from the veterans. I am still quite young.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我觉得最大的核心竞争力
captions.en: I think the greatest core capability

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 就是你能组织到别人组织不到的资源，快速地变现
captions.en: is organizing resources others cannot reach and monetizing them quickly.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我觉得这就是超级个体
captions.en: That, to me, is a super individual.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 所以这也是我不断去组织这个会议的一个初衷
captions.en: That is also why I keep organizing these meetings.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我会不断地每个月去组织不同的人、不同的资源进来
captions.en: Every month, I will keep bringing in different people and resources.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 这样的话，我们团队会越来越大，团体会越强大
captions.en: This way, our team will grow larger and stronger.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 因为我自身认为一件事情就是
captions.en: One thing I firmly believe is this:

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 当你跟就在同一个行业里面
captions.en: when you work alongside others in the same field,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 然后一块去做的时候，大家都好的时候
captions.en: and everyone around you is doing well,

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 你自然不会差，自然不会差
captions.en: you naturally will not fall behind. You will not fall behind.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 不是说你自己一个超级个体要做得多强、多牛逼
captions.en: A super individual does not need to be exceptionally powerful alone.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我觉得超级个体一定是要做到资源共享、资源整合
captions.en: A super individual must share and integrate resources.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 有一个项目，大家有能力一块扑上去干
captions.en: When a project comes, everyone with the right skills works on it together.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 然后做完之后大家散，对吧
captions.en: When it is done, everyone moves on. Right?

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我觉得这是最牛逼的超级个体
captions.en: To me, that is the most powerful kind of super individual.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 这也就是希望我们未来能够持续走下去
captions.en: That is why I hope we can keep moving forward together.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 持续组织的这样的一个动力
captions.en: It is what motivates us to keep organizing these events.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 这个也是我们的第一次，也是我的第一次
captions.en: This is our first time, and it is my first time too.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 所以说，我觉得这个起点非常好
captions.en: I think this is a very good starting point.

captions.speaker: 主持人
captions.zh: 我会坚持继续做下去，感谢大家的到来
captions.en: I will keep doing this. Thank you all for coming.
